comparison_contract: One bounded no-cache local V8 decision arm over 16,384 checksum-pinned Cohere Medium 1M 768D vectors, 2,000 logical cells, 32 separately opened one-lane writer processes, one CPU and two blocking-I/O workers per child, production batching, k=10, a 16-candidate shortlist, and 20 post-drain reads. The residual-pq64-f32-error shadow cannot change hits or physical reads. Promotion requires every correctness and recall invariant, zero containment failures, survivor p95 <=11, pooled DP-optimal exact-read and byte reductions >=30%, certificate CPU within the frozen bound, <=68 certificate bytes per vector, and total uncached backing bytes <=2x unchanged exact backing bytes. The shared ingest and drain are the honest zero-difference control for read-only shadow overhead; the absolute physical write-amplification gate and 68-byte format bound separately constrain V8 storage cost. The decision must report latency/CPU tails, scan waves, DP minima, allocations, and gaps to structural or empirical floors. The 200ms read p95 is only a rejection ceiling: passing it does not freeze a default unless the candidate is on the fastest observed correctness-preserving Pareto frontier. This arm is ineligible for AWS, 100M-scale, or competitor claims.
